'''Cladus Glynn''' was an officer in the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]], and was stationed on [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]] during the height of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
His role was to locate any [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] personnel moving through the [[Kothlis system/Legends|Kothlis system]], specifically at the [[Kothlis shadowport]]. To help him gather information, Glynn assumed the guise of [[Gart (Human)|Gart]], the drunken spacer who claimed to know the location of a [[ganjuko]] graveyard, after the ISB captured and interrogated him.<ref name="graveyard">{{WEGCite|story=The Ganjuko Graveyard|book=Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide}}</ref>

Expecting an Imperial team to arrive in a few [[Local day/Legends|days]], he was stationed in a warehouse in a [[Warehouse district (Tal'cara)|Warehouse district]] of [[Tal'cara]], posing as the fearful drunkard, hunted by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]], as well as the [[Bothan cult]]ists.<ref name="graveyard" /> 

When a team of adventurers came to him asking for directions to the graveyard, he found the opportunity to use them as an armed escort before betraying them. At that time, undercover ISB agents staged a fight against mercenaries of [[Beldonna's League]], to reinforce the guise.<ref name="graveyard" />

After preparations, the cultists attempted to stop them as they departed the city and tried to outnumber them. However Glynn's associates were shadowing him and his escorts, and sniped at the cultists during the fight, thus allowing the travelers to leave the city.<ref name="graveyard" />

Near the graveyard, they saw that the [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] [[hunting/Legends|hunter]] [[Rathleek]] and [[Rathleek's hunting band|his band]] got there first, going for the ganjuko beaks; with hit-and-run tactics they tried to dissuade them from advancing. Glynn managed to lead the prospectors to a hidden valley, where they discovered that the ganjukos were killed by a [[Meteorite/Legends|meteorite]] impact.<ref name="graveyard" />

Right then they were attacked again by Beldonna's mercenaries, who followed them, as well as some cultists who wore ganjuko skulls. Near the end of the battle, a [[Speeder truck/Legends|speeder truck]] showed up with ten agents, escorted by four [[Scout trooper/Legends|scout troopers]]; they were Glynn's reinforcements. Glynn then attacked the Rebels, and as the agents tried to arrest them, Glynn attempted to get hold of the meteorite and run into the truck.<ref name="graveyard" />

==Personality and traits==
Glynn was a cunning agent, young and strong. He had brown hair and small pug-like nose. Despite this, he could convinsingly disguise himself as the middle-aged and overweight Gart.<ref name="graveyard" />
